prompt: Create an original 60 second cool jazz instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: muted trumpet, vibraphone, double bass, brushes. Style: spare melodic answers, extended chords and unhurried swing. Tempo approximately 74 BPM; D major. Main idea: alternating short and long phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A melancholic and nostalgic instrumental piece featuring a prominent cornet melody, accompanied by clarinet, double bass, and light percussion. It evokes a classic, jazzy, and slightly whimsical atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首忧郁怀旧的器乐曲，以小号（或短号）为主旋律，配以单簧管、低音提琴和轻柔的打击乐。营造出一种经典、爵士且略带异想天开的氛围。
